author: Dave's Garage
description:
Dave does something to fix the bloat by writing a version of Notepad that is only 2686 bytes, and that's the total executable size!  Check out an episode of ShopTalk on Dave's Attic where we answer the best user questions!

https://youtu.be/ZUvDO2g5Y1s

Get Tiny Retro Pad: https://github.com/plummersSoftwareLLC/TinyRetroPad
title: Tired of Bloated Windows? I Fixed Notepad (2.5KB)
